title: Jendela
overview: Bimo and his father had just allowed going home by train after doing Bimo’s surgery. On the train, they just realized that their relationship is not like other father-son-relationship. Theirs feels just like a formality, which is written in the family card. In fact, they made a boundary between them and it felt awkward. Some words were spoken if they’re needed to. In his silence, Bapak (Father) couldn’t hide his guilt until Bimo saw a piece of paper in the rucksack.
